subject: english
question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Competent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"competent"** means having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully. (सक्षम)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a **competent** teacher who understands the needs of her students.
 
 
 
• **"Qualified" **means meeting the proper standards and requirements for a job, task, or responsibility. (योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He is highly **qualified **for the position of project manager due to his extensive experience.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Qualified**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gullible **(अविश्वासी): Easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.

 
 
• **Example:** Children are often very gullible and believe anything you tell them.
 
 
 
• **Widened **(फैलाया हुआ): Made or become wider.
 
 
• **Example: **The path was widened to allow more traffic to pass through.
 
 
 
• **Untried** (अनमोल): Not yet tried or tested.
 
 
• **Example:** They were hesitant to use the untried and untested technology in their project..

The correct answer is: Option 4.</
